Common questions.

New to hiring a driver, or thinking of driving with Roadly? Start here, then register when you’re ready.

Register
Is Roadly a ride-hailing app?

No. Roadly brings professional drivers to vehicle owners. You provide the vehicle, choose the driver who suits you, and hire them by the day, week or month.

Do drivers need their own vehicle?

No. The client provides the vehicle, including the motorcycle for riders. The driver operates it on the terms agreed with the client.

How are drivers verified?

Every driver’s NIN is verified, and their ID, licence and police character certificate are checked. Their profile photo must match their ID photo and a 15-second live check, at 90% or more on both. Our team reviews every application. Read about safety

When is my payment released?

You see the total, including 7.5% VAT, before you pay. Payment is held in escrow and released when the job is complete and you rate the driver.

What if my vehicle is damaged or fuel goes missing?

At check-in and check-out the driver records the odometer, fuel gauge and vehicle condition with photos. Any damage or fuel claim is reviewed against that record.

Where is Roadly available?

Roadly is launching in Abuja and Lagos, with more of Nigeria to follow. Join the waitlist

Privacy notice

Last updated: October 2026

Who we are

Roadly is operated by Roadly Mobility, a business name registered under Fik’iri Mama Limited, a company registered in Nigeria with the Corporate Affairs Commission. RC: 1900378. Registered office: 24 Ekoro Oruro River Street, Maitama, Abuja, Nigeria. Contact: info@roadlymobility.com or info@fikirimama.com.

What we collect on this website

When you join the waitlist, we ask for your name, whether you are a client (individual or company), a driver or a rider, your city, and a phone number or email address. We use these details only to contact you about Roadly’s launch in your city.

We do not collect identity documents, police certificates, licences, vehicle documents, bank details or payment details through this website.

Why we use your details

We use your details with your consent, which you give when you tick the box on the waitlist form. You can withdraw consent at any time by writing to us.

Who we share your details with

We do not sell your details. Our team at Roadly can see them. We may use a service provider, such as an email or hosting provider, who processes them on our instructions under a written agreement. Waitlist responses are collected through Zoho Forms. Registration details are received through Netlify Forms, the service that hosts this website.

How long we keep them

We keep waitlist details until Roadly launches in your city or until you ask us to delete them, whichever comes first.

Your rights

Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, you can ask to access, correct, or delete your personal data, and to withdraw consent. Write to info@fikirimama.com. We will respond within the time the Act requires.

Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your details. Email is not a fully secure channel, so do not send sensitive information by email.

Job applications

If you apply for a job, we collect your CV, your cover letter, your contact details and anything else you choose to include. We use them to assess your application and to arrange assessments and interviews. Applications are collected through Zoho Forms. Only the people running recruitment at Roadly can see them.

We do not ask for identity numbers, bank details or identity documents at the application stage. We keep applications only for as long as the recruitment process needs them, and we delete them when you ask us to. You can ask to see, correct or delete your information at any time at info@roadlymobility.com.

Complaints

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, contact us first. You can also contact the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.

Changes

We may update this notice. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

In the Roadly app

When you register and use the Roadly app, we collect what is needed to check and match people safely:

  • Drivers: gender, date of birth, National Identity Number (NIN) verified with the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) through a verification provider, an ID photo, a police character certificate, a profile photo, a 15-second live video used for a face match, licence details and category, guarantor and emergency contact details, payout details, the areas you cover, working hours and whether you drive at night.
  • Clients: for individuals, gender, date of birth and an ID photo. Companies register through an HR or admin contact, and no individual gender is asked for.
  • Vehicles and trips: vehicle details and photos, check-in and check-out records (odometer, fuel gauge and vehicle condition), and location while trip sharing is on.
  • Communication: calls and messages made through Roadly. Phone numbers are not shown to the other person.

You can see and change your choices in Settings and privacy in the app.

Terms of use

Our terms of use will be published on this page before driver and client registration opens. Until then, this website is for information and for joining the waitlist. It does not create a booking, a contract or a payment obligation.

Cookie notice

This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. The waitlist form is provided by Zoho Forms, which may set cookies under its own cookie policy. The fonts on this site are served with the site itself, not by a third party. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

If something is hard to use, email info@roadlymobility.com. We are improving accessibility as the platform develops.

About Roadly

Roadly is a technology-driven driver-as-a-service marketplace. It connects individuals and companies with verified, professional drivers who operate the client’s own vehicle, and it lets clients find drivers, match them by area, tier and pay type, book, and pay securely.

Launching in Abuja and Lagos, with a vision to expand across Nigeria, Africa and beyond, we serve individual vehicle owners and families, executives who need a chauffeur, corporate fleets, and companies that need professional driver staffing.

Founder’s story

Roadly started with a simple observation. Skilled drivers want steady work, while families, businesses and companies need dependable drivers they can trust. The gap between them is about access, and technology can close it.

Akinade Segun founded Roadly after working across logistics, fleet operations, procurement and business management.

“Our goal is simple: connect the right driver to the right opportunity.”

Akinade Segun, founder · LinkedIn

Our mission

To simplify professional driver hiring through smart technology, connecting skilled drivers with reliable earning opportunities and delivering flexible, trusted services to individuals and businesses.

Our vision

To become Africa’s leading technology-driven driver marketplace, transforming professional mobility through innovation and economic empowerment.
